ww._note: Isolation is triggered when a folder is ATTACHED to WOLFSPACE (POST /ww/attach), not by a fixed-root watcher — a folder can live anywhere. Set watch:true only if you want every new folder under 'root' isolated automatically. Leave 'root' empty to use the default; this file SHIPS IN THE INSTALLER, so a path here becomes every user's default.

reaktif._note: The agent watches the workspace and reports on its own. It can ONLY READ — the run is handed a tool array with no writing tools in it (see hanyaBaca in agent/self_agent.ts). Limits live in agent/reaktif.ts: a 20s quiet period after the last change, 90s minimum between reports, 12 reports an hour. Set aktif:false to stop it entirely.
